# Amazon Location Service

Skills that teach agents to work with Amazon Location Service. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [awslabs/agent-plugins](https://github.com/awslabs/agent-plugins), at commit `097fe8a`.

Guide developers through adding maps, places search, geocoding, routing, and other geospatial features with Amazon Location Service, including authentication setup, SDK integration, and best practices.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Amazon Location Service**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Amazon Location Service**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install amazon-location-service@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skill: `amazon-location-service`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
